Try itNumbers in the code, or parameters

The controller's four numbers each change with the job. try it

In the codeValue
Target90°
Gain1.5
Speed limit1.0 rad/s
Tolerance0.02 rad
  1. Another target. Turning to 180° instead of 90° means editing the .cpp and building again.
  2. Tuning. A good gain is found by trying values. With constants, every try is edit, build, run.
  3. Another robot or world. In GP2, controller_node drives the GP1 stand-in robot and the ROSbot in Gazebo, each run with its world's YAML file.
Values that change with the task, the robot or the world belong outside the code: in parameters, which you set when the node starts or while it runs.
